title: MarketView, where next
subtitle: 24 people: 10 agroprocessors, 10 input distributors, 4 research organisations. Answered once.
updated: Last updated on Wednesday 23 September at 6pm. The board only changes when something new comes in, such as a check-in, a report, a decision or a number from another system.

short.heading: In short
lines: Processors and distributors both point to Kano maize first, and processors would pay for it.
Researchers want the same markets but a different product: history, not daily prices.
short.foot: 21 of 24 answered, each on their own, once.

groups.heading: By who they are
groups.note: What each group said it needs

cards.title: Agroprocessors
lines: Daily maize and soybean prices in Kano and Kaduna
Would pay: 7 of 9, for a named buyer feed
Want it in their ERP, not a new app

cards.title: Input distributors
lines: Where farmers are buying, by LGA
Would pay: 3 of 8; want it free for a pilot
Wary of sharing their own sales figures

cards.title: Research organisations
lines: Would pay through grants, not subscriptions
Offer their survey data in exchange

ranked.heading: Where next, ranked
ranked.note: From how many said it, and who

disagree.heading: Where they disagree

sides.quote: “Daily prices or it’s no use to us. Monthly is history.”
“Daily numbers without methodology won’t pass review. We need consistent monthly series.”

disagree.foot: Both can be served from the same collection: daily for processors, monthly averages for researchers.

cant.heading: What this can’t tell you
cant.text: Whether anyone will actually pay: willingness was said, not tested. And the three who didn’t answer are all distributors outside Kano.
